claim_traces.claim_text: "MSG (monosodium glutamate) causes headaches, numbness, and other symptoms — so-called 'Chinese restaurant syndrome.'"
reasoning_steps: The claim that monosodium glutamate (MSG) causes headaches, numbness, and other symptoms collectively referred to as "Chinese restaurant syndrome" (or MSG symptom complex) has been debunked by extensive scientific research
The concept originated from an anecdotal letter published in the New England Journal of Medicine in 1968
Since then, rigorous, double-blind, placebo-controlled studies conducted by health authorities, including the U.S

Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the Joint FAO/WHO Expert Committee on Food Additives (JECFA), have repeatedly failed to establish a causal link between normal dietary MSG consumption and these reported symptoms

The FDA classifies MSG as "Generally Recognized as Safe" (GRAS), noting that the body metabolizes glutamate added as seasoning identically to naturally occurring glutamate found in foods like tomatoes and parmesan cheese.

claim_traces.claim_title: Social media causes depression in teenagers
claim_traces.claim_text: "Social media use causes depression and anxiety in teenagers."
reasoning_steps: While numerous studies and health advisories (such as from the U.S

Surgeon General) show a strong correlation between high levels of social media use and increased symptoms of depression and anxiety in adolescents, a definitive causal link remains heavily debated among researchers

Prominent scholars and systematic reviews emphasize that the majority of research is correlational rather than experimental, making it difficult to establish directionality—depressed or anxious teens may spend more time on social media rather than social media causing their symptoms

Additionally, researchers like Amy Orben and Andrew Przybylski argue that aggregate effect sizes across large datasets are relatively small and mediated by specific factors like sleep deprivation, cyberbullying, or passive versus active use, rather than screen time itself.

claim_traces.claim_title: Generative AI will replace 300 million jobs
claim_traces.claim_text: "Generative AI will replace 300 million jobs worldwide."
reasoning_steps: The claim is based on a March 2023 Goldman Sachs economic report, but mischaracterizes its findings

The report estimated that generative AI could expose the equivalent of approximately 300 million full-time jobs to automation, rather than definitively predicting that 300 million jobs "will be replaced." In labor economics, exposure to automation means tasks within those jobs could be automated, with the authors noting that for most affected occupations, AI is likely to complement rather than fully substitute human labor

Furthermore, the report emphasized that technological automation historically drives productivity growth and creates new jobs, making the assertion of an outright net elimination of 300 million jobs misleading.

claim_traces.claim_title: US Congress passed no budget on time since 1997
claim_traces.claim_text: "The US Congress has not passed a complete federal budget on time since 1997."
reasoning_steps: Under the Congressional Budget Act of 1974, the federal fiscal year begins on October 1, by which point Congress is required to enact all regular appropriations bills (now numbering 12) to fully fund the government on time

According to data from the Congressional Research Service and analyses by organizations such as the Pew Research Center, Congress has enacted all required regular appropriations bills before the start of the fiscal year in only four instances: fiscal years 1977, 1989, 1995, and 1997
Since fiscal year 1997, Congress has consistently relied on continuing resolutions, omnibus spending packages, or enacted appropriations well past the October 1 deadline.

claim_traces.claim_title: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood
claim_traces.claim_text: "Octopuses have three hearts and their blood is blue."
reasoning_steps: Scientific consensus confirmed by marine biology sources establishes that octopuses possess three hearts and blue blood
Two branchial hearts pump blood through the gills to collect oxygen, while a single systemic heart circulates blood through the rest of the body
Their blood is blue because it relies on hemocyanin, a copper-based oxygen-transport protein that is particularly efficient in cold, low-oxygen aquatic environments.
